## How it was tested

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] if the window changed: launched it and exercised the change (layout edits are in `src/window/*.ui`)
- [ ] `docs/` updated if behaviour, options or shortcuts changed
